title: Manager Client Operation and Audit
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Manager – Client Operations & Audit Company: JBR Consulting Experience: 5–8 Years Department: Operations & Client Management 1. Role Overview We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented professional who can independently manage project operations, lead a team, handle client relationships and ensure timely execution of all assigned activities. The individual will be responsible for driving team productivity, managing client and dealer escalations, monitoring audit activities, ensuring reporting discipline and maintaining overall operational efficiency. 2. Key Roles & Responsibilities 1. Team Management - Lead and manage a team of 7–10 members. - Allocate responsibilities, monitor individual performance and ensure timely completion of assigned tasks. - Drive accountability, productivity and discipline within the team. 2. Client Management - Act as the primary point of contact for clients and dealership management. - Manage day-to-day client communication and ensure expectations are met. - Conduct periodic reviews and provide updates on project progress and deliverables. 3. Escalation Management - Handle client and dealer escalations independently. - Investigate issues, coordinate with relevant stakeholders and ensure timely resolution. - Proactively identify critical matters and escalate them to senior management. 4. Audit & Process Monitoring - Supervise internal audit activities across automobile dealership sales and service operations. - Ensure adherence to defined processes, policies and compliance requirements. - Review audit findings, identify deviations and ensure appropriate corrective actions. 5. Reporting & MIS - Ensure timely and accurate preparation of daily, weekly and monthly reports. - Review MIS, dashboards, audit summaries and management presentations. - Analyse data to identify gaps, trends and areas requiring management attention. 6. Task & Project Management - Monitor project deliverables, track pending activities and follow up with team members. - Ensure all assignments are completed within agreed timelines. - Identify operational bottlenecks and implement improvements to enhance efficiency. 3. Desired Skills & Qualifications - Graduate in Commerce, Management or a relevant discipline. MBA will be an added advantage. - 5–8 years of experience in operations management, internal audit, consulting or client management. - Prior experience in team management and client-facing roles. - Knowledge of automobile dealership operations, particularly sales and service processes, will be an added advantage. - Strong command of MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and data analysis. - Good PowerPoint skills for preparing management presentations. - Excellent communication, leadership, analytical and problem-solving abilities. - Ability to independently manage multiple responsibilities and deliver within strict timelines. 4. Key Expectations The ideal candidate should be a strong executor with excellent ownership capabilities, someone who can manage people, clients and processes independently. We are looking for an individual who can take responsibility for overall project execution, drive accountability within the team and ensure that every commitment made to the client is delivered on time.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

Benefits:

title: Factory Production Manager
description:
**About The Company**

At Aesthetik Engineers Ltd., We Specialize In Transforming Spaces With Innovative Facades, Aluminum Doors, Windows, Gfrc, And Railings. Since 2 Decades, We've Been A Trusted Partner For Architects, Builders, And Homeowners, Offering Premium Glass, Windows, And Façade Solutions. Our Blend Of Technology And Craftsmanship Ensures Exceptional Results And Redefines Architectural Design.

**Job Responsibilities**

**A. Production & Factory Operations**

* Plan, organise and supervise day-to-day factory operations.
* Ensure timely execution of production schedules as per project requirements.
* Oversee fabrication and manufacturing of aluminium doors, windows, curtain walls, structural glazing, ACP cladding, skylights and other façade systems.
* Monitor production targets, productivity and operational efficiency.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of machinery, equipment and manpower.
* Coordinate with the Projects, Design, Purchase and Stores departments.

**B. Manpower Management**

* Manage factory workforce, including supervisors, technicians, fabricators, welders and helpers.
* Allocate duties and responsibilities to production teams.
* Monitor employee attendance, discipline, performance and productivity.
* Identify manpower requirements and coordinate recruitment and training.
* Ensure proper shift management and workforce utilisation.

**C. Quality Control**

* Ensure that all manufactured products meet approved drawings, specifications and quality standards.
* Monitor fabrication accuracy, dimensions, finishing and workmanship.
* Implement quality inspection procedures at different stages of production.
* Coordinate with the QA/QC team to minimise rejection, rework and material wastage.
* Ensure corrective actions are taken for quality-related issues.

**D. Material & Inventory Management**

* Coordinate with the Purchase and Stores departments for timely availability of raw materials.
* Monitor consumption of aluminium sections, glass, ACP sheets, hardware, accessories and other materials.
* Maintain proper stock records and material movement.
* Minimise material wastage, pilferage and unnecessary consumption.
* Ensure proper storage and handling of materials.

**E. Machinery & Maintenance**

* Ensure proper functioning and maintenance of factory machinery and equipment.
* Plan preventive maintenance schedules.
* Monitor breakdowns and ensure timely corrective maintenance.
* Maintain machinery maintenance records.
* Ensure proper utilisation of fabrication machines, cutting machines, CNC machines, welding equipment and other tools.

**F. Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with factory safety standards and applicable statutory requirements.
* Implement workplace safety procedures and ensure the use of appropriate PPE.
* Maintain housekeeping and proper material storage practices.
* Conduct regular safety inspections and coordinate safety training.
* Ensure fire safety equipment and emergency arrangements are maintained.
* Coordinate with the HR/Admin team for factory-related statutory compliance and documentation.

**G. Dispatch & Coordination**

* Ensure timely completion, packing and dispatch of fabricated materials as per project schedules.
* Coordinate with project teams regarding production priorities and delivery timelines.
* Ensure proper identification, labelling and documentation of dispatched materials.
* Resolve operational issues affecting production and delivery schedules.

**H. Reporting & Documentation**

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly production reports.
* Monitor production output, rejection, wastage and machine downtime.
* Maintain records of manpower, material consumption, inventory and maintenance.
* Report operational challenges and production delays to management.
* Recommend process improvements and cost-reduction measures.

**3. Required Qualifications**

* Diploma / B.Tech / B.E. in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering or a relevant technical discipline.
* Additional qualifications in Manufacturing or Industrial Management will be an advantage.

**4. Experience**

* Minimum 8–12 years of experience in manufacturing or fabrication operations.
* Relevant experience in the Architectural Façade, Aluminium, Glass or Structural Glazing industry is preferred.
* Prior experience managing factory operations, production teams and industrial machinery is essential.

**5. Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Excellent production planning and execution capabilities.
* Knowledge of aluminium and glass fabrication processes.
* Understanding of façade systems, structural glazing and curtain wall manufacturing.
* Knowledge of AutoCAD drawings and fabrication/shop drawings.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* Knowledge of quality control, inventory and material management.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work under production deadlines and project delivery pressure.

**6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The performance of the Factory Manager will be evaluated based on:

* Achievement of production targets and schedules.
* Timely completion of project-related fabrication and dispatch.
* Reduction in material wastage and production costs.
* Reduction in rejection, rework and quality complaints.
* Effective manpower utilisation and productivity.
* Machinery uptime and preventive maintenance.
* Compliance with safety standards and factory regulations.
* Inventory accuracy and material control.
* Overall factory efficiency and operational discipline.

**Overall Responsibility:** The Factory Manager shall be responsible for ensuring smooth, safe, efficient and cost-effective factory operations while meeting the company's production, quality and project delivery commitment.

Pay: ₹70,000.00 - ₹90,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

title: Factory Operations Manager – Food Processing
description:
**Company:** Basulimata Agro Foods LLP  
**Location:** West Bengal, India  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, On-site  
**Experience:** 4–8 Years  
**Salary:** ₹25,000 – ₹45,000 per month (Negotiable based on experience and expertise)

**Job Overview**

Basulimata Agro Foods LLP is looking for an experienced and technically proficient Factory Operations Manager to independently manage and oversee its complete food processing and manufacturing operations.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the entire factory lifecycle, including raw material processing, cleaning, sorting, grading, quality control, packaging, inventory management and finished goods preparation for domestic and international markets.

The ideal candidate must possess strong knowledge of food technology, industrial food processing machinery, automated production systems and factory management. The person will be responsible for supervising existing factory workers, ensuring production efficiency, maintaining product quality and implementing effective operational procedures.

The candidate will report directly to company management.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Factory & Production Management**

* Independently manage and oversee all day-to-day factory operations.
* Plan, organise and monitor daily, weekly and monthly production activities.
* Ensure production targets are achieved within specified timelines.
* Manage the complete production cycle, from raw material intake to finished product packaging.
* Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for factory operations.
* Monitor production efficiency, resource utilisation and operational costs.

**2. Workforce & Labour Management**

* Supervise, manage and coordinate existing factory workers, machine operators and production staff.
* Allocate daily responsibilities and production duties.
* Monitor worker attendance, discipline, productivity and performance.
* Organise work shifts and ensure adequate manpower allocation.
* Provide operational training and ensure workers follow safety and hygiene procedures.
* Maintain an efficient and productive working environment.

**3. Food Processing Machinery & Automation**

* Possess practical knowledge of industrial food processing and manufacturing machinery.
* Understand the operation, configuration and maintenance of automated processing and packaging systems.
* Supervise machinery used for cleaning, sorting, grading, processing, weighing and packaging.
* Identify suitable machinery and technologies for different agricultural food products.
* Evaluate machinery capacity, performance and production efficiency.
* Implement preventive maintenance schedules and coordinate machinery servicing.
* Identify opportunities for automation and production-line improvements.

**4. Food Processing & Product Management**

* Oversee processing operations for agricultural and food products, including rice, puffed rice (muri), dried red chilli, soya chunks and other agro-food products.
* Ensure appropriate cleaning, sorting, grading, processing and packaging procedures.
* Monitor product quality, consistency, moisture levels and contamination risks.
* Optimise processing methods to improve product yield and reduce wastage.
* Ensure products meet the required specifications of international buyers.

**5. Quality Control & Food Safety**

* Establish and implement quality control procedures throughout the production process.
* Ensure compliance with applicable FSSAI regulations and food safety requirements.
* Implement and monitor GMP, HACCP and hygiene standards.
* Conduct and supervise raw material, in-process and finished product inspections.
* Maintain batch-wise quality records and production traceability.
* Ensure proper sanitation, pest control and safe storage practices.
* Coordinate product testing and inspections whenever required.

**6. Inventory & Warehouse Management**

* Monitor raw material, packaging material and finished goods inventory.
* Maintain accurate stock and consumption records.
* Monitor production yield, wastage, rejected materials and stock losses.
* Ensure appropriate storage conditions and stock rotation.
* Coordinate material requirements with procurement and company management.
* Ensure proper inventory reconciliation.

**7. Packaging, Storage & Export Readiness**

* Supervise bulk packaging and customised/private-label packaging operations.
* Ensure correct packaging specifications, weights, labelling and batch identification.
* Maintain product quality during storage and handling.
* Ensure finished products meet buyer specifications and applicable export requirements.
* Coordinate with the export and logistics teams for timely order fulfilment.

**8. Reporting & Operational Improvement**

* Prepare regular production, inventory and factory performance reports.
* Monitor production output, machine downtime, wastage and operational costs.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and implement corrective measures.
* Recommend improvements in machinery, processes and production methods.
* Report factory performance, operational issues and resource requirements directly to company management.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* B.Tech / B.Sc / M.Tech in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering or an equivalent relevant discipline.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in food processing, agro-processing, FMCG or food manufacturing.
* Previous experience managing factory production operations and supervising factory workers is essential.
* Strong practical knowledge of industrial food processing machinery and automated production systems.
* Good understanding of food safety, quality control, HACCP, GMP and FSSAI regulations.
* Experience in production planning, inventory management and operational cost control.
* Ability to independently manage factory operations and take operational decisions.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in rice mills, grain processing, spice processing, agricultural food processing or packaged food manufacturing.
* Knowledge of optical sorting, grading, cleaning, weighing and automated packaging machinery.
* Experience with export-oriented food processing and international quality standards.
* Knowledge of ISO 22000 and other relevant food safety management systems.
* Experience in machinery installation, commissioning and production-line optimisation.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for a hands-on professional who understands both the technical and managerial aspects of food manufacturing. The candidate must be capable of independently running factory operations, managing existing workers, handling machinery-related challenges and ensuring consistent production quality.

Candidates with practical factory management experience and strong knowledge of food processing technologies will be preferred.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹45,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Facility Manager - Soft
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Facility Manager
  
Work Dynamics
  
  
**What this job involves:**  
Leading on-site operations
  
Are you a pro at giving on-site support? Working with a team, you’ll oversee the day-to-day client activities for the assigned property or facility. You’ll also implement building procedures and performance measures—and ensure that they are maintained at all times. Likewise, you’ll boost on-site operations by promoting best practices and creating better processes. This job will also entail the question “How do I ensure the safety of my colleagues?” You will do this by promoting adherence to health and safety standards.
  
  
Winning our clients’ trust
  
As the facilities manager, you’ll be working frequently with clients, so you’ll need to build strong relationships with them. Likewise, you’ll need to be proactive and engaging; and make sure that the clients’ expectations are met each and every time. You will also be the go-to person for any facilities-related concerns.
  
  
Keeping an eye on budget and contracts
  
Do you have a solid background in finance management? As the person in charge, you will take care of the site’s financial operations. Also part of your job is to coordinate with vendors and suppliers, and make sure that they deliver quality work practices according to the contract, and at the right cost.
  
  
Promoting teamwork across the board
  
At JLL, we strongly believe that teamwork is the secret behind every successful company. Do you share our thoughts? If so, then you are what we’re looking for. In this role, you will support our people’s growth and development through effective training and coaching sessions. Likewise, you’ll promote a culture that upholds the ‘I am JLL’ core behaviours and fosters teamwork, cooperation and performance excellence. Also part of your job is to ensure that the team is constantly motivated, and that trust and work ethics prevail among members.
  
  
**Sound like you? To apply, you need to be:**  
Competent and goal-driven
  
Do you have three to five years’ experience of managing a property? If so, you will be a perfect fit for the role. Likewise, an experience in managing commercial contracts and budgets may just help you land this job. You’ll also need to be a goal-oriented individual who’s an ace in health and safety requirements, vendor management and property technical systems management
  
  
Organised and analytical
  
We’re looking for a self-motivated and quick-thinking facilities manager who can solve problems using quantitative methods and holistic approaches. Likewise, we’re on the lookout for well-organised leaders who plan tasks in advance and constantly stay ahead of deadlines.
  
Engaging and professional
  
A passion for excellence is what makes a great facilities manager. We’ll need someone who can do more than the bare minimum to meet our clients’ expectations. In this role, you’ll also be working with different kinds of people, so you’ll need to be an expert in handling them professionally. Likewise, you’ll need to effectively manage, train and inspire the team to always do better. You’ll also need to take the time to listen to your people to create better work impact.
  
  
What you can expect from us
  
  
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realize your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  
Apply today!
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Textile Operations Lead (Production, Merchandising & Quality)
description:
Job Overview

Anuprerna Artisan Alliance is seeking an experienced, proactive **Textile Production & Merchandising Manager** to lead end-to-end textile operations, quality assurance, and artisan cluster management.

In this pivotal operational role, you will bridge client requirements and on-ground production. You will be responsible for translating design and client orders into structured production plans, managing Time & Action (T&A) calendars, overseeing raw material procurement and dyeing/weaving processes, enforcing strict quality standards, and directly leading field supervisors and artisan teams.

The ideal candidate brings deep technical knowledge of yarns, natural fibers, weave structures, and finishing, paired with hands-on commercial merchandising acumen and the leadership ability to ensure on-time, defect-free delivery.

Key Responsibilities. Production Planning & Cluster Execution

* Develop, monitor, and execute comprehensive Time & Action (T&A) production calendars across all running orders to ensure 100% on-time delivery.
* Plan loom capacities, manage yarn consumption matrices, and allocate production runs across internal units, weaver clusters, and external dyeing facilities.
* Track work-in-progress (WIP) from raw yarn procurement, warping, and dyeing through weaving, washing, finishing, and packing.
* Proactively identify production bottlenecks, material shortages, or weather-dependent delays, implementing rapid corrective actions.

2. Textile Merchandising & Costing

* Coordinate order specifications, approvals, and buyer requirements from initial sampling through bulk dispatch.
* Prepare accurate Bill of Materials (BOM), cost breakdowns, fabric yields, and consumption estimates for custom developments and commercial collections.
* Manage sampling cycles, lab dips, strike-offs, and counter-samples, obtaining formal sign-offs before bulk production rollout.
* Serve as the technical link between internal management/sales and field execution teams.

3. Quality Assurance & Technical Control (QA/QC)

* Establish and implement standardized inspection protocols across raw materials (yarn count, strength, twist), in-line weaving, and final fabric finishing.
* Supervise physical testing parameters including GSM, dimensional stability (shrinkage), colorfastness, rub fastness, and weaving defect tolerances (utilizing 4-Point System or relevant international standards).
* Audit dyeing units (natural and azo-free certified processes) to ensure batch-to-batch shade consistency and lot integrity.
* Conduct root-cause analysis on defects and implement preventive measures to systematically drive down rejections.

4. Team Leadership & Artisan Management

* Direct and mentor on-site supervisors, quality checkers, logistics staff, and weaver cluster coordinators.
* Foster fair, professional, and productive relationships with artisan networks, weavers, and dyeing partners.
* Maintain clean production ERP records, inventory audits, and regular status reports for executive management.

Candidate Profile & Eligibility Criteria

* **Education:** Degree or Diploma in Textile Technology, Textile Engineering, Textile Design, or Apparel Production (e.g., GCETT, NIFT, or recognized textile institutes).
* **Experience:** 4 to 8+ years of hands-on experience in textile production, merchandising, or quality assurance within textile mills, handloom/powerloom clusters, export houses, or sustainable textile enterprises.
* **Technical Mastery:** In-depth knowledge of fiber classifications, yarn counts, weave constructions (plain, twill, dobby, jacquard), GSM analysis, dyeing mechanics, and post-loom finishing treatments.
* **Process Knowledge:** Familiarity with handloom, artisanal textile techniques, natural fibers (silk, linen, cotton), and eco-conscious or sustainable finishing standards is strongly preferred.
* **Operational Skills:** High proficiency in creating and managing T&A schedules, fabric costing, and inventory tracking using MS Excel / Google Sheets or textile ERP tools.
* **Languages & Leadership:** Strong cross-functional leadership skills. Ability to communicate effectively with artisans and local weavers in Bengali, along with professional working proficiency in English or Hindi for reporting.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund
